# RUH CODE Pull Request

## Scope
- RC IDs:
- TASK IDs:
- Calculation core affected: [ ] No [ ] Yes
- Release artifact affected: [ ] No [ ] Yes

## Required evidence
- [ ] Requirement text was checked against the binding master specification; no RC was skipped, merged, weakened, or renumbered.
- [ ] Relevant unit/regression tests pass.
- [ ] CI required checks pass before merge.
- [ ] TR/EN behavior was checked when applicable.
- [ ] Offline behavior was checked when applicable.
- [ ] Free/PRO behavior was checked when applicable.
- [ ] Backup/PDF/security/accessibility/performance impacts were checked when applicable.
- [ ] Requirement matrix evidence is truthful; implementation alone is not marked DONE.

## Calculation-core review (required when affected)
- [ ] Calculation algorithm/version change is documented.
- [ ] Independent/golden evidence is attached or the missing evidence remains an explicit blocker.
- [ ] A reviewer other than the author has approved the calculation-core change.

## Release governance
- [ ] This change was developed on a feature branch, not by treating `main` as the daily development branch.
- [ ] No release branch/tag is created by this PR unless all final release gates are green.
- [ ] Exact release artifact provenance (commit SHA, workflow/run, artifact hash/signing evidence as applicable) is retained for release-producing changes.

## Blockers / unresolved evidence
List every blocker explicitly. Do not convert a blocker into DONE by checklist wording.
